# full-example

Argsbarg full example reference app

## Execution

Invoke via shell:

```bash
full-example <subcommand> [options] [args]
```

## Commands

- **`full-example echo`** — Echo a message (MCP-friendly leaf).
- **`full-example render-json`** — Echo a JSON message (schema-first JSON leaf demo).
- **`full-example status`** — Show app version. (flags: --json)
- **`full-example workspaces get`** — List workspaces.
- **`full-example workspaces post`** — Create a workspace.
- **`full-example workspaces :id get`** — Get one workspace.
- **`full-example workspaces :id put`** — Replace a workspace.
- **`full-example workspaces :id patch`** — Patch a workspace name.
- **`full-example workspaces :id delete`** — Delete a workspace.

## Pitfalls

- Pass `--` before arguments that look like flags.
